description: Engineering specifications (design inputs). Single source of truth used by evaluate_concepts.py for pass/fail and by docs/02_specifications.md. Priority: * = must be met; ** = tradeoff acceptable (BME Design, Table 4.3 convention).

specs.metric: MAE of forecast MAP vs true MAP over the next 15 s (held-out synthetic)
specs.source: ISO 81060-2 (BP device accuracy: mean error within 5 mmHg); clinical need for trustworthy numbers

specs.need: Detect deterioration before it is missed
specs.metric: Sensitivity of DETERIORATING-or-higher alert for true future MAP < 65 mmHg
specs.source: Benchmark: FDA-cleared Hypotension Prediction Index reports ~0.88 sensitivity (Hatib et al., Anesthesiology 2018)

specs.need: Do not alarm on stable patients
specs.source: Benchmark: Hypotension Prediction Index ~0.87 specificity (Hatib et al., 2018)

specs.metric: False alert episodes per monitored patient-hour
specs.source: 72-99% of clinical alarms are false (Sendelbach & Funk, AACN Adv Crit Care 2013); Joint Commission NPSG.06.01.01

specs.need: Warn earlier than a conventional monitor
specs.metric: Median paired lead-time advantage of the first WATCH-or-higher alert over a conventional threshold monitor with identical alarm management, per hypotension onset (MAP < 65)
specs.source: Project need: alert before deterioration is obvious on the bedside monitor (concept brief)

specs.need: Risk estimate separates patients who will and will not become hypotensive
specs.metric: AUROC of P(MAP < 65) for true future MAP < 65
specs.source: Standard discrimination benchmark for clinical prediction models

specs.metric: Corrupted windows handled safely (abstain or drop the bad channel)
specs.source: ISO 14971 risk control (FMEA R-01); IEC 60601-1-8 technical vs physiological alarms

specs.metric: Median within-patient correlation of estimated R and C with ground truth
specs.source: Project objective: latent haemodynamic state estimation

specs.metric: Agreement of intervention-response status with ground truth
95th-percentile per-update latency on CPU (no GPU at bedside)
specs.source: 1 s update period; IEC 62304 performance requirement

specs.need: Works on real patients, not only simulations
specs.metric: MAE of forecast MAP vs arterial line on held-out VitalDB cases
specs.source: External validity; arterial line as clinical reference standard

specs.need: Support handoff, audit and quality review
specs.source: Concept 5 brief; Design History File and audit needs

specs.need: Remain decision support, never prescribe therapy
specs.source: Intended use; FDA CDS guidance (2022); ethics (Ch. 13)

specs.need: Never falsely reassure during critical hypotension
specs.metric: Share of windows with true MAP < 55 mmHg displayed only as STABLE or WATCH
specs.source: Hazard H-09 found in verification (ISO 14971); fail-safe principle: losing information must never lower an alarm
